gloss: to transfer out; to move out (of a jurisdiction)

definitions.gloss: to transfer out; to move out (of a jurisdiction)
definitions.explanation: To officially deregister from a municipality when relocating to another area. Also used for leaving a school to transfer elsewhere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{転出|てんしゅつ}する。
examples.english: I'm moving out of this city next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転出|てんしゅつ}{届|とどけ}→転出届：09810_tenshutsutodoke⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: You need to submit the transfer-out notification before moving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{転出|てんしゅつ}→転出：25698_tenshutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: Young people keep moving away, and the population of this town is decreasing year by year.

notes:
The administrative counterpart to ⟦{転入|てんにゅう}する→転入する：26917_tennyuusuru⟧. When leaving a municipality, residents must file a ⟦{転出|てんしゅつ}{届|とどけ}→転出届：09810_tenshutsutodoke⟧ (transfer-out notification) and receive a ⟦{転出|てんしゅつ}→転出：25698_tenshutsu⟧⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧ (transfer-out certificate), which is then presented at the new municipality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{転出|てんしゅつ}{届|とどけ}→転出届：09810_tenshutsutodoke⟧: transfer-out notification
- ⟦{転出|てんしゅつ}→転出：25698_tenshutsu⟧⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧: transfer-out certificate
- ⟦{転出|てんしゅつ}→転出：25698_tenshutsu⟧⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: person moving out; departing resident
- ⟦{転出|てんしゅつ}→転出：25698_tenshutsu⟧⟦{超過|ちょうか}→超過：04523_chouka⟧: net outmigration
- ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦{転出|てんしゅつ}→転出：25698_tenshutsu⟧: population outflow

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{転入|てんにゅう}する→転入する：26917_tennyuusuru⟧: to transfer in — the opposite; officially registering in a new municipality
- ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧: to move (house) — the everyday word for physically relocating
- ⟦{退去|たいきょ}→退去：06693_taikyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to vacate; to leave — focuses on physically leaving a building or premises
